# AIREA Solutions

> Performance & AI Creative Studio leveraging the latest AI workflows, proprietary IP, and human expertise in every decision and execution. A Fractional Growth Department for hospitality, retail, and lifestyle brands — replacing fragmented agencies with one integrated system of paid media, AI creative, CRM, and measurement.

AIREA is led by Nicolas Santos (Fractional CMO). Based in New York City and Miami. We serve restaurants, rooftop venues, boutique hotels, fashion & apparel, salons, and founder-led lifestyle brands. Every client engagement is strategy-led by Nicolas — no junior account managers, no sales reps.

Our proprietary systems include:
- **NOVA** — AI Creative Studio producing magazine-grade photography, cinematic video, and ad creatives at a fraction of traditional production cost.
- **The Andromeda Protocol** — algorithmic Meta creative testing system: 50+ variations per month, AI-driven winner scaling, -40% CPA, 3.5x average ROAS lift.
- **AIREA Performance Framework** — Google Ads architecture: PMAX for local dominance, NTM/TM/Competitor Conquest segmentation, delivering +120% conversions at sub-$2 CAC.

## Flagship Product

- [NOVA — AI Creative Studio](https://aireasolutions.com/nova): Proprietary AI creative engine for brand photography, product shots, lifestyle imagery, and video. Fraction of traditional production cost, unlimited iteration, on-brand at scale.

## Growth Pillars

- [Amplify — Performance Marketing](https://aireasolutions.com/amplify): Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok paid media run like a quantitative trading desk.
- [Intelligence — AI Workflows & Technology](https://aireasolutions.com/intelligence): Custom AI workflow design, process automation, internal tool development, tech stack optimization, AI education.
- [Reach — Email, SMS & CRM](https://aireasolutions.com/reach): Lifecycle marketing, retention flows, first-party data strategy.
- [Engage — Content & Social](https://aireasolutions.com/engage): Social strategy, video production, AI photoshoots, brand identity, ad creative.
- [Analyze — Data & Insights](https://aireasolutions.com/analyze): Real-time dashboards, attribution, revenue forecasting, strategic reviews.
- [Build — Web & Development](https://aireasolutions.com/build): React, Webflow, Shopify, custom development, technical SEO.
